design_axis: shared-brand non-color focus / selection state-treatment logic
bounded_question: Can one restrained structural grammar distinguish default, keyboard focus, selected, focus+selected and disabled states across neutral APP-like and WEB-like carriers without depending on candidate color, motion, iconography, imagery, material, bespoke typography, semantic status meaning, product-specific vocabulary, or CLR-01?
authority_limits: CLR-01 remains PAUSED and unchanged; no Director color-family selection is inferred.
STA-01 concerns supporting focus/selection state treatment only, not semantic product states or interaction behavior.
No outcome selects production component tokens, final identity, implementation or Phase-C convergence.

controlled_inputs.carrier_type: native button element with neutral grayscale CSS

F1.name: Conventional Ring + Fill
F1.selection: neutral soft fill plus heavier boundary

F2.name: Ring + Edge Witness
F2.selection: persistent edge witness plus boundary; inline-start vertical in APP, low horizontal in WEB

F4.name: Weight + Depth
F4.selection: font-weight increase plus static 1px lift and 3px depth shadow

excluded_variables: Threshold K, O3 or other brand marks
Character, Stage, Performance, Take, Opportunity or product-state semantics

source_freeze.note: The exact harness bytes were frozen before hosted-browser evidence. Earlier local static inspection is scratch/preflight context only and authorizes no family mutation after this freeze.

checks: no prohibited carrier sources or identity effects
programmatic focus produces :focus-visible with >=2px non-none outline
focus+selected retains the selected-only family's non-color selection carrier
disabled remains disabled and not aria-pressed
F2 selected edge witness remains structurally present in forced colors
F3 selected bracket witnesses remain structurally present in forced colors
F4 forced-colors selected box-shadow is none
source contains reduced-motion suppression and no authored animation/transition identity carrier

subjective_falsification_after_clean_pre: focus and selection collapse into one state
selected state primarily reads as editing/cropping/resize tooling
state carrier becomes more visually authoritative than neutral content
APP and WEB cease to read as the same underlying mechanism
mechanism is too generic to add useful identity beyond platform convention
mechanism implies product semantics absent from the fixture

result_law.promotion_scope: bounded state-treatment mechanism for later packet composition only
